entities.name: Mindrel
entities.description: Planeswalker who lost her left ear in a magical experiment and was friends with Brand.

entities.name: Brand
entities.description: Refugee planeswalker who planned to learn dark magic and died defending the Outer Ring.

entities.name: Outer Ring
entities.description: Place defended by Brand; challenged by planeswalkers of Mindrel's plane.

events.summary: Brand died defending the Outer Ring against another wizard after ignoring Mindrel's warning about dark magic.
events.quote: Brand did not heed her warning and died a short time later defending the Outer Ring against another wizard.

events.summary: Mindrel visited Brand's home plane and found a destroyed world and the lifeless body of Brand's familiar.
events.quote: but she found only a destroyed world and the lifeless body of Brand's familiar by his fireplace.

relations.quote: She was friends with the refugee planeswalker Brand .
